recipes.name: Screen stars
recipes.description: For star-only data prepared for screen recombination.

recipes.name: Add stars
recipes.description: For star-only data prepared for additive recombination.

recipes.name: SHO channel mapping
recipes.description: RGB document with SII, Ha, and OIII already present as aligned grayscale-valued RGB layers; use channel 0 from each.

recipes.name: HOO channel mapping
recipes.description: RGB document with aligned grayscale-valued Ha and OIII layers; use channel 0 from each.

recipes.name: Add
recipes.description: Add both layers. Values above 1 require an output range choice.

recipes.name: Subtract
recipes.description: Subtract B from A. Negative values require an output range choice.

recipes.name: Multiply
recipes.description: Multiply corresponding samples in A and B.

recipes.name: Divide
recipes.description: Divide A by B. A zero denominator is an error; no epsilon is substituted.

recipes.name: Difference
recipes.description: Absolute difference between corresponding samples.

recipes.name: Minimum
recipes.description: Keep the lower value at each pixel and channel.

recipes.name: Maximum
recipes.description: Keep the higher value at each pixel and channel.

recipes.name: Average
recipes.description: Equal-weight average of both layers.

recipes.name: Overlay
recipes.description: Overlay B on A. Swapping inputs changes the result.

recipes.name: Soft light
recipes.description: Apply the documented soft-light formula with A as the base.

recipes.name: Invert
recipes.description: Invert normalized samples; HDR values remain unclipped.

recipes.name: Gain and offset
recipes.description: Scale brightness and add a constant offset.

recipes.name: Subtract background
recipes.description: Subtract a constant background. Choose new 32-bit output to preserve negatives.

recipes.name: Midtones stretch
recipes.description: Stretch samples in 0 to 1; midtones must be between 0 and 1.

recipes.name: Gamma
recipes.description: Power stretch of nonnegative samples. Use a positive gamma.

recipes.name: Threshold mask
recipes.description: Create a binary mask independently for each channel.

recipes.name: Screen stars with strength
recipes.description: Recombine stars at adjustable strength. Start at 0–1; larger values can exceed the output range.

recipes.name: Extract screen stars
recipes.description: Invert screen recombination for normalized layers. Fully saturated starless samples are unrecoverable and explicitly return 0.

recipes.name: Logarithmic stretch
recipes.description: Compress highlights and lift shadows. Use positive strength and nonnegative input samples.

recipes.name: Black and white points
recipes.description: Map black to 0 and white to 1. Require white > black. Output is not automatically clipped.

recipes.name: Soft threshold mask
recipes.description: Ramp from 0 at low to 1 at high. Require high > low. Each channel is evaluated independently.

recipes.name: Range mask
recipes.description: Select a closed sample interval independently in each channel.

recipes.name: Masked blend
recipes.description: Use a prepared full-canvas raster mask: 0 keeps A, 1 selects B. RGB masks act per channel.

recipes.name: RGB average grayscale
recipes.description: RGB documents only. Arithmetic channel average, not a colorimetric luminance conversion.

recipes.name: Saturation around RGB average
recipes.description: RGB documents only. 0 gives channel-average gray; 1 retains color. Above 1 can produce negative or HDR values.

recipes.name: Channel gains
recipes.description: RGB documents only. Independently scale red, green and blue samples.

recipes.name: Swap red and blue
recipes.description: RGB documents only. Exchange red and blue without changing green.

recipes.name: Detail boost from blurred layer
recipes.description: Use a separately prepared aligned blurred raster layer. Layer Math does not generate the blur. Overshoot may need 32-bit output.
